checks.title: Decoys reachable beyond loopback
checks.detail: All 2 sensor(s) bind to loopback; only local clients can reach them.

checks.title: Relaxed safety opt-ins
checks.detail: No safety opt-in is relaxed; loopback binding, unprivileged ports and public-only LLM egress remain enforced.

checks.title: Attacker input sent to an LLM provider
checks.detail: No sensor forwards attacker input to a model provider (provider: local, fallback sensors: 0).

checks.title: Evidence copies leaving this host
checks.detail: No webhook or fleet forwarding is configured; evidence stays on this host.

checks.title: Operator role separation
checks.detail: The console is disabled; operator roles were not evaluated.

checks.title: Honeytokens configured
checks.detail: No honeytokens are configured, so a replayed decoy credential cannot be recognised (HT-001, COR-008).
checks.recommendation: Generate markers with 'aegismesh honeytoken new' and plant them in decoy responses.

checks.title: Agent canary marker
checks.detail: No honeytokens are configured (see POS-007), so no agent canary exists.
checks.recommendation: Add an agent_canary marker; following it is the strongest AI-agent signal (AGT-001).

checks.title: Detection engine and rules
checks.detail: Detection is enabled with every rule active.

checks.title: Correlation engine and rules
checks.detail: Correlation is disabled, so cross-sensor signals (COR-001..COR-008) such as cadence and credential replay are never produced.

checks.title: Detection actions change decoy responses
checks.detail: Decoy responses change when rules fire (medium=isolate, high=refuse). These actions affect only the decoy, never other systems, but an adaptive client can notice the change.
checks.recommendation: Use observe for severities where staying convincing matters more than slowing the client.

checks.title: Sensors without retained observations
checks.detail: No observations among the 11 retained events examined: quiet-tcp. A quiet decoy is not a fault.
checks.recommendation: If traffic was expected, check the listener is reachable from where attackers would come from.

checks.title: Analysis sample saturation
checks.detail: 11 retained event(s) fit within the 8192-event analysis sample.

checks.title: Evidence encryption at rest
checks.detail: Evidence is stored unencrypted; it is redacted but still holds attacker-supplied text and source addresses.
checks.recommendation: Enable storage.encryption if the data directory is backed up or shared.

disclaimer: Static review of the running configuration and of retained evidence; not a security guarantee or a complete audit.
